provenance.source: Wikidata, matched against the occupation terms this archive uses
provenance.note: Built from the corpus outward: the occupation values on the person records plus the civic and military titles the name policy strips. A candidate is kept only if it is an occupation or a position by P31/P279*, because a plain search for Rancher returns a surname and an album. Terms marked local have no Wikidata equivalent and are the archive's own.
